summary: Ready for the producer. All three round-1 notes are fixed well. s06 now shows the clock error correctly: three equally wrong distances meet at a ghost point about 300 m off, the fourth ring misses it, and correcting the clock pulls all four rings onto the true spot. It also reuses the tilted s05 view, so viewers see one visual language throughout. s05's 3D beat is now fully flat 2D (vertical squash and skew, equator ellipses, 20% opacity silhouettes) with cues for the dimension label, and s03's tags and single receive badge are easy to build and read. Style, palette and the blue-dot motif stay consistent, the cues land on the right words, and every mustCover item is shown. The notes below are optional polish for the animator and do not need another round.

notes.issue: This is the busiest scene: 10 animation beats in about 17 seconds, and two pairs share a cue ('three hundred meters wrong' and 'until the spheres meet'). If they fire at the same moment, the key ghost-dot and fix moments could blur together.
notes.suggestion: Stagger beats that share a cue: let the rings finish growing before the ghost dot and '~300 m off' label appear, and let the four rings settle before the blue dot and 'Clock fixed' pop in. Hold the final blue dot for about half a second before the transition.

notes.issue: The on-screen text uses British spelling ('Within a few metres') but the narration and later labels are neutral ('~300 m off').
notes.suggestion: Pick one spelling for on-screen text, e.g. 'Within a few meters' to match the narration, or simply 'Within a few m'. This is a small consistency fix the animator can make directly.
